user.title: Set up water softener
user.description: Counts regenerations via smart plug power and energy metrics and tracks salt levels.

data_description.power_entity: Sensor reporting active power in Watts [W] from your smart plug.
data_description.energy_entity: Sensor reporting cumulative energy consumption in kWh or Wh from your smart plug.
data_description.power_threshold_w: Power in Watts [W] above which the regeneration motor is considered active.
data_description.energy_threshold_kwh: Energy in kWh consumed required to detect a regeneration.
data_description.detection_mode: Criterion to identify a regeneration: energy, power, both, or either.
data_description.capacity_kg: How many kilograms of salt fit into the brine tank?
data_description.per_regen_kg: How many kilograms of salt does one regeneration cycle use?
data_description.initial_stock_kg: Optional. Leave empty if the tank is full right now.
data_description.window_start_hour: Start of the time window (optional, leave empty for 24-hour monitoring).
data_description.window_end_hour: End of the time window (optional, leave empty for 24-hour monitoring).
data_description.warn_remaining: From this calculated remaining stock on, the 'Refill salt' problem sensor turns on.

error.window_incomplete: Please specify both start and end hours, or leave both empty for full 24-hour monitoring.
error.window_invalid: The end of the time window must be after its start.
error.per_regen_too_large: Salt per regeneration must not exceed the tank capacity.
error.stock_too_large: The current salt stock must not exceed the tank capacity.
error.power_threshold_invalid: Power threshold must be greater than 0.
error.energy_threshold_invalid: Energy threshold must be greater than 0.

refill.name: Salt refilled
refill.description: Confirms that salt was refilled. The amount in kg is required and is added to the stock (at most up to full). The 'Refill salt' sensor turns off once the stock is above the warning threshold.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

kg.name: Amount refilled
kg.description: Amount in kg that was added.

set_salt_stock.name: Set salt stock
set_salt_stock.description: Sets the calculated salt stock to a specific value (e.g. after checking the tank).

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

add_regeneration.name: Add regeneration
add_regeneration.description: Manually adds a regeneration that was not detected (counter and salt stock are adjusted).

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

set_last_regeneration.name: Set last regeneration
set_last_regeneration.description: Sets the time of the last regeneration (e.g. from the softener's display). Determines 'Next regeneration at the latest' and the 'Regeneration overdue' status. Counters and salt stock stay unchanged.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

datetime.name: Time
datetime.description: Date and time of the last regeneration (not in the future).

set_regenerations_since_refill.name: Set regenerations since refill
set_regenerations_since_refill.description: Sets the known regenerations since the tank was last filled up. The salt stock is calculated from it: tank capacity minus count × salt used per regeneration.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

count.name: Count
count.description: Regenerations since the tank was last filled up.
